title: Sheep Goats
description: Turns sheep into goats! Thats it!
body:
Turns sheep into goats! What do you mean we already have goats? We need more goats. We need more goats.

Features custom sounds and renames mutton to chevron!

More Goats!

This pack really gets my Goat!

I love Goats!

Goats!

**REQUIRES _'Entity Model Features/Entity Texture Features'_**
